displayPattern: Amber status LED on a Carrier 59SC5: 1 short flash, then 1 long flash (code 11)
meaning: No previous code. The service label says stored status codes are erased automatically after 72 hours.
causes: The control has no stored fault to display
diySteps: Count 1 short flash and 1 long flash. Code 11 means there is no stored fault, not that a part has failed
The troubleshooting chart in the same manual says to run the system through a heating or cooling cycle to check it. Stored codes are erased after 72 hours
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician if the furnace still will not heat or cool after a full cycle. Code 11 itself is not a failed part. A flash pattern other than 11 is the fault to look up.
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
sourceTitle: Carrier 59SC5A installation, start-up, operating and service instructions (Catalog No. 59SC5A-01SI), Fig. 55 service label. Read 2026-11-07
